title: The work is quiet,
titleAccent: and there is a lot of it.
intro: Chairs get carried, calls get answered, someone new writes at midnight frightened by what they felt in meditation. None of it is glamorous. All of it is the movement. Tell us where you would like to stand.
serveLabel: Where you would like to serve
serveHint: Choose as many as you mean. Somebody will read this by hand.

teams.title: Events — on the ground
teams.desc: Setting up halls, chairs, mats, sound and signage. Arrive early, leave last.

teams.title: Helpline — first level
teams.desc: Answer the first message or call, understand what is being asked, and pass it to the right team.

teams.title: Local event volunteer
teams.desc: Host or help run sits and gatherings in your own city.

teams.title: Experiences & doubts — for seasoned meditators
teams.desc: Members write in about what rose in meditation — kundalini stirrings, heat, fear, something they cannot name. You have sat long enough to answer plainly and leave them unworried.

teams.title: Donor member
teams.desc: Give regularly so the teachings stay free for everyone else.

teams.title: Social media
teams.desc: Write, film, edit and post — carry the work to people who have not heard of it.

teams.title: Tech
teams.desc: The website, the streams, the member tools. Anything that has to keep working.

availLabel: How much time can you give?
noteLabel: Anything you want us to know
notePlaceholder: Skills, languages you speak, when you are usually free, or why this matters to you.
steps: Your note reaches a coordinator for each team you chose — not a queue, a person.
They write back to understand what you enjoy and what you would rather not do.
You are added to that team’s circle and start at whatever pace suits you.
smallBody: One event a year is help. Answering three messages a week is help. Say what is true and we will never ask for more than that.
sentTitle: Thank you for offering to serve.
sentBody: Thank you — we have your note.
footerSub: Every hour offered keeps the sits free and the doors open.
